info.title: Journal Entry Item - Read (A2X)
info.description: The service contains journal entry items and master data of the referenced company code, cost center, profit center. This API call is based on the OData protocol, and can be consumed in Fiori apps and on other user interfaces

x-sap-shortText: Read journal entry items synchronously from the universal entries line item table and the referenced company code, cost center, and profit center information in detail using this inbound service

x-sap-extensible.description:
If you are working with key user extensibility, the API can be extended by custom fields on the following business contexts (field usage for this API needs to be selected):
* Accounting: Coding Block (FINS_CODING_BLOCK)
* Cost Center Master Data (FINS_COST_CENTER)
* Accounting: Journal Entry Item (FINS_JOURNAL_ENTRY_ITEM)
* Accounting: Market Segment (FINS_MARKET_SEGMENT)
* Profit Center Master Data (FINS_PROFIT_CENTER)

[How to add an extension field to an API](https://help.sap.com/docs/ABAP_PLATFORM_NEW/b5670aaaa2364a29935f40b16499972d/ce819b8557194ae0aa180ba4ac6a04de.html)

Note: Please make sure to match the release selected in SAP Business Accelerator Hub with the Feature Pack (FPS) on help page.
